pageQuotes.excerpt: Northwest Region NSF I-Corps Hub 0 Skip to Content Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Who We Are Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply Open Menu Close Menu Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Who We Are Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply Open Menu Close Menu Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Folder: Who We Are Back Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply NSF I-Corps Hub Northwest Transform your innovative technology into a startup About us The NSF I-Corps Northwest Hub offers Lean Startup courses, where teams of STEM innovators learn how to apply the scientific method to business in order to find the best path to commercialization. Learn More Samay wouldn’t be what it is today without the help of the NSF I-Corps. As a first-time founder without business experience, learning the ins and outs of customer discovery positioned us to get into the most competitive national programs and secure almost $2M in grant awards from NSF and NIH. Whenever I meet an early-stage founder, especially those who are not well represented in the tech industry (women and POC), I always tell them to complete this course before spending any time fundraising or building a product. Maria Artunduaga Founder, Samay Medical Doctorate (MD) Pontificia Universidad Javeriana Master of

Maria Artunduaga Founder, Samay Medical Doctorate (MD) Pontificia Universidad Javeriana Master of Translational Medicine (MTM) UCSF/University of California, Berkeley Master of Public Health (MPH) University of Washington NSF I-Corps is designed for academic researchers and early stage founders to validate their commercial market and de-risk the technology commercialization process.
Teams with an early stage tech innovation based startup or startup idea in the Northwest Region (Northern California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska) are eligible to apply.

Northwest Region NSF I-Corps Hub 0 Skip to Content Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Who We Are Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply Open Menu Close Menu Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Who We Are Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply Open Menu Close Menu Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Folder: Who We Are Back Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply National NSF I-Corps 7 weeks, 100 customer interviews, and a 50K non-dilutive NSF grant to validate product market fit Teams who complete the Intro to Lean Startup: NSF I-Corps Method program with instructor endorsement are eligible to apply for the National NSF I-Corps program, an immersive 7-week training that comes with a $50,000 NSF grant for customer discovery. Teams conduct 100 customer feedback interviews and receive a clear yes or no on product market fit. Teams who complete the National NSF I-Corps program have a much higher funding rate, including SBIR grants and investments. For NSF SBIR Phase I grants, NSF I-Corps alums have a ~50% win rate, vs 15-20% for the general applicant pool. Northwest Region NSF I-Corps Hub 0 Skip to Content Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Who We Are Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply Open Menu Close Menu Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Who We Are Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply Open Menu Close Menu Regional I-Corps Program National I-Corps Program Folder: Who We Are Back Leadership & Faculty Tech Scouts Blog Contact Login Account Apply NSF I-Corps Training Each month, NSF I-Corps Hub Northwest offers no cost market validation courses for university researchers and early stage startup founders About the Program NSF I-Corps Hub Northwest trains early stage teams with a fundamental technology innovation to validate their commercial market and find a scalable business model through the customer discovery process. During a free 2-4 week course, learn from proven entrepreneurs how to conduct 20 customer discovery interviews, identify your top customer segment & value props, and accelerate finding product market fit. Teams that complete the Regional course, have university IP, and receive Hub recommendation may be eligible to continue to the 7 week National NSF I-Corps program, which includes a $50,000 National Science Foundation grant. Program Timeline Eligibility Requirements Team of 2-4 people No technology commercialization or
Team Size - Each application is required to have a team of 2-4 members, typically comprised of university faculty, students, researchers, or recent alums.
Early stage startup founder teams located in Northern California, Oregon, Washington, and Alaska are also eligible.

Technology Innovation - NSF I-Corps is designed both for early stage technology based startups in the Northwest Region (Northern California, Washington, Oregon), and for early stage teams who develop a new fundamental discovery in science or engineering at a university or academic lab.
Early Stage - If you have a startup idea and the customer discovery process is completely new to you, you’re in the right place.
If you are an early stage technology based startup in the Northwest Region (Northern California, Washington, Oregon), we welcome you to apply.
